interpretation: At every resolution, either the state machine fails to find any takeoff/apex/water_contact at all (720p, native_1080p -- the trajectory is too flat/static to trigger a velocity-crossing anywhere), or it finds landmarks 1.3s EARLY (360p -- a different systematic error direction than the previous cycle's +1.4s LATE result, because this fresh N0 run's false-positive lock happens to sit at a different point in the state machine's search). Neither failure mode is a meaningful measurement of V2.2's takeoff-threshold design: both trace back to PHASE_B_PARIS_SPARSE_IDENTITY_AUDIT.json's finding that the input trajectory is not, for most of the clip, the diver.
conclusion: Paris external result remains REAL_SIGNAL_CANARY_FAIL, as it did for V2.1.
